mapper.sql: FROM ultary_report r LEFT JOIN ultary_feed f ON r.target_type='FEED' AND f.feed_id=r.target_feed_id LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON r.target_type='COMMENT' AND c.feed_comment_id=r.target_comment_id LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_reply rp ON r.target_type='REPLY' AND rp.feed_reply_id=r.target_reply_id WHERE CASE r.target_type WHEN 'USER' THEN r.target_user_no WHEN 'FEED' THEN f.user_no WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN c.user_no WHEN 'REPLY' THEN rp.user_no END =

u.user_no,u.nickname,u.name,u.withdrawal_status AS status,u.created_at,u.suspended_at,u.withdrawal_completed_at, CASE WHEN u.email IS NULL OR u.email='' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(u.email,1),'***@',SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.email,'@',-1)) END AS masked_email, CASE WHEN u.phone IS NULL OR u.phone='' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('***-****-',RIGHT(REPLACE(u.phone,'-',''),4)) END AS masked_phone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ultary_pet p WHERE p.user_no=u.user_no AND p.is_deleted=0) AS pet_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ultary_feed f WHERE f.user_no=u.user_no AND f.is_deleted=0) AS feed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) u.user_no) AS report_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_social s WHERE s.user_no=u.user_no AND s.provider='GOOGLE') AS google_linked, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_social s WHERE s.user_no=u.user_no AND s.provider='KAKAO') AS kakao_linked, (SELECT p.profile_file_id FROM ultary_pet p WHERE p.user_no=u.user_no AND p.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY p.priority,p.pet_id LIMIT 1) AS profile_file_id

where.if: AND (LOCATE(#{q},u.nickname)>0 OR CAST(u.user_no AS CHAR)=#{q} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ultary_pet p WHERE p.user_no=u.user_no AND p.is_deleted=0 AND LOCATE(#{q},p.name)>0))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM ultary_user u ORDER BY u.user_no DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM ultary_user u WHERE u.user_no=#{userNo}
SELECT feed_id,content,visibility,is_deleted AS deleted,created_at FROM ultary_feed WHERE user_no=#{userNo} ORDER BY feed_id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT r.report_id,r.target_type,r.status,r.reason,r.created_at #{userNo} ORDER BY r.report_id DESC LIMIT 20

where.if: AND (LOCATE(#{q},admin_login_id)>0 OR LOCATE(#{q},admin_name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{q},target_label)>0 OR CAST(target_id AS CHAR)=#{q} OR CAST(admin_no AS CHAR)=#{q})

choose.when: SELECT withdrawal_status AS after_status,CONCAT('@',nickname) AS target_label FROM ultary_user WHERE user_no=#{id}
SELECT status AS after_status,CONCAT('신고 #',report_id) AS target_label FROM ultary_report WHERE report_id=#{id}
SELECT CASE WHEN is_deleted=1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS after_status, CONCAT('스토리 #',story_id) AS target_label FROM ultary_story WHERE story_id=#{id}
SELECT CASE WHEN is_deleted=1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS after_status, CONCAT('게시글 #',feed_id) AS target_label FROM ultary_feed WHERE feed_id=#{id}
SELECT CASE WHEN is_deleted=1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS after_status, CONCAT(name,' pet') AS target_label FROM ultary_pet WHERE pet_id=#{id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT j.admin_review_status AS after_status,CONCAT(l.target_type,' #',l.target_id) AS target_label FROM ultary_ai_request_log l LEFT JOIN ultary_ai_moderation_job j ON j.job_id=l.moderation_job_id WHERE l.ai_request_id=#{id}

mapper.select: SELECT 'STORY_DELETED' AS type, s.story_id AS id, s.deleted_at AS occurred_at, s.file_id AS file_id, s.thumbnail_file_id AS thumbnail_file_id FROM ultary_story s WHERE s.user_no=#{userNo} AND s.is_deleted=1 AND s.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.deleted_at DESC, s.story_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'FEED_DELETED' AS type, f.feed_id AS id, f.deleted_at AS occurred_at, f.content AS content FROM ultary_feed f WHERE f.user_no=#{userNo} AND f.is_deleted=1 AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ultary_feed_media m WHERE m.feed_id=f.feed_id) ORDER BY f.deleted_at DESC, f.feed_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'PET_DELETED' AS type, p.pet_id AS id, p.deleted_at AS occurred_at, p.name AS pet_name, p.profile_file_id AS file_id FROM ultary_pet p WHERE p.user_no=#{userNo} AND p.is_deleted=1 AND p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.deleted_at DESC, p.pet_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'PASSWORD_CHANGED' AS type, u.user_no AS id, u.password_changed_at AS occurred_at, '비밀번호가 변경 되었습니다' AS message FROM ultary_user u WHERE u.user_no=#{userNo} AND u.password_changed_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT 'NICKNAME_CHANGED' AS type, u.user_no AS id, u.nickname_changed_at AS occurred_at, '닉네임 태그가 변경 되었습니다' AS message FROM ultary_user u WHERE u.user_no=#{userNo} AND u.is_default_nickname=0 AND u.nickname_changed_at IS NOT NULL AND u.nickname_changed_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) LIMIT 1

SELECT 'ACCOUNT_WITHDRAWN' AS type, u.user_no AS id, u.withdrawal_completed_at AS occurred_at, '해당 계정이 탈퇴 처리되었습니다' AS message FROM ultary_user u WHERE u.user_no=#{userNo} AND u.withdrawal_status='WITHDRAWN' AND u.withdrawal_completed_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT p.name FROM ultary_content_pet c JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id=c.pet_id WHERE c.content_type=#{type} AND c.content_id=#{id} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.pet_id
SELECT COALESCE(m.thumbnail_file_id, m.file_id) FROM ultary_feed_media m WHERE m.feed_id=#{feedId} ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.feed_media_id ASC
SELECT user_no FROM ultary_feed WHERE feed_id=#{feedId} AND is_deleted=1 LIMIT 1
